The medication container serves as a reservoir for the medication and a source of inhaled aerosol. It allows you to accurately measure the amount of medicine you consume during inhalation. Replacement vials are particularly useful if you need to administer more drugs in a short time or if, despite careful hygiene and disinfection, bacterial contamination or contamination of the administered drugs has occurred, or if the vial is mechanically damaged. The ideal solution is also to change the containers regularly at least once every six months.
